paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Jerusalem Talmud, Bava Batra, chapter 10, halakhah 8, speaking in Rav’s name.[^1]

notes.text: The stored Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra10:8 scalar explicitly has Rabbi Ami bar Korcha reporting in Rav's name. This supports Ami's Rabbi expansion, the work locator and transmission direction; Korcha remains untitled.
